inherited.M01: BCIC2020-III, MentalArithmetic, and BCI Competition IV-2a collection protocols; NeuroTTT introduces no new user action during training-data collection.
inherited.M04: The imagined-phrase, mental-arithmetic stress-detection, and motor-imagery task actions come from the benchmark protocols; test-time model adaptation is handled in M03.
inherited.M05: EEG acquisition channels, sampling rates, and dataset sensor setups are inherited from BCIC2020-III, MentalArithmetic, and BCI Competition IV-2a; preprocessing follows the CBraMod pipeline.
inherited.M06: CBraMod and LaBraM backbones and the downstream classification-head design are inherited; training-only auxiliary objectives are classified in M02.
inherited.M07: The benchmark tasks use their closed-set class labels without a use-time language model, lexicon, or other linguistic decoding aid.
inherited.M08: Outputs are the benchmark's phrase, stress, or motor-imagery class labels.
inherited.M09: The inherited offline dataset-classification pipelines have no interactive presentation, confirmation, or commit stage.
inherited.M10: The inherited offline dataset-classification pipelines have no user correction, re-entry, or action-adjustment stage.
inherited.M11: Ground-truth class labels are inherited from BCIC2020-III, MentalArithmetic, and BCI Competition IV-2a.

topics.inclusion_rule: Neural-signal decoders (EEG, MEG, intracranial) that start from a checkpoint pretrained on large neural corpora (the 40-study neural foundation-model population) and, during supervised fine-tuning, add a training-only self-supervised loss (signal-transformation prediction, reconstruction, contrastive or pretext targets) to the task loss. Boundary: pretraining objectives used only before fine-tuning are excluded; use-time updates are M03; versions of one study count once; full-text pattern hits are an upper bound.
topics.pattern: neural foundation-model pattern of the published M03 table (ledger)
topics.design_field: M03 supervision_kind; full-text design regexes (self-supervised loss added to supervised fine-tuning; domain-specific pretext task)
topics.rebuilt: replaces prep topic eeg-domain-specific-self-supervision (design regexes were key=value strings; population not the foundation-model fine-tuning population)

topics.inclusion_rule: Decoders of speech-related or neural signals (any modality: EEG, intracranial, EMG, ultrasound, video) that update model weights or normalization state from unlabeled test data at use time (self-supervised test-time training, entropy minimization such as Tent, pseudo-label self-training, source-free adaptation). Boundary: training-only auxiliary losses are M02; supervised recalibration on labeled target data is excluded; flip or crop test-time augmentation without parameter updates is a pattern match only; citing-only mentions count as full-text hits; versions count once.
topics.pattern: test-time adaptation/training, Tent, entropy minimization, source-free, TTA/TTT, unsupervised adaptation, pseudo-label at test (ledger) + test-time full-text pattern
topics.design_field: full-text regexes: pseudo-label, entropy minimization, SSL test-time training, re-centering
topics.rebuilt: replaces prep topic eeg-test-time-adaptation (pattern matched 448 studies, usual approach supervision_kind=other)

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that report classification results on the 2020 International BCI Competition Track 3 imagined-speech data (15 subjects, five words or phrases, 64-channel EEG), including the organisers' review, classified by the test data scored: the competition's released test trials, the public validation subset used as test, cross-validation, or held-out subjects. Boundary: papers that only cite the dataset, and multi-dataset benchmarks where Track 3 results are not reported separately, are pattern matches only; versions count once.

Speech-related or neural-signal decoders (any modality) whose text ties test-time or online adaptation, or inference, to latency, runtime, memory, compute, power or wearability. Boundary: training-only cost is excluded; privacy or edge-suitability claims without a measurement count as pattern matches only; versions count once.
topics.design_field: full-text regexes: latency in ms, memory or FLOPs, edge device
topics.rebuilt: replaces prep topic test-time-adaptation-operating-cost (usual approach was a lifecycle field value)

dropped: M03 neural-foundation-model-speech-transfer (inherited CBraMod/LaBraM checkpoints; the published table lists the target itself as state of the art)
